channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: On Accession Day, Mehbooba reminds Centre of promises, says ‘trust broken’
item.description: October 26 was introduced as an official holiday in J&K during the Central rule in 2020, immediately after the abrogation of provisions of Article 370 in 2019

item.title: A.P., Odisha on alert as cyclone ‘Arnab’ nears land | LIVE
item.description: IMD issues red alerts for seven of the 28 districts in Andhra Pradesh for October 27

item.title: Ruling NC to reshuffle, expand J&K Cabinet on October 27; ally Congress to stay away
item.description: J&K Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha will administer the oath of office and secrecy to legislators into the Council of Ministers at Lok Bhavan Auditorium in Srinagar

item.title: Bihar MLC polls: RJD MP Sanjay Yadav writes to ECI to ensure transparent counting
item.description: In the letter, Sanjay Yadav said that pens of the same type as the violet pens used for marking preferences on ballot papers during polling must not be available to any counting officer or election agent at the counting centre

item.title: Amid alleged liquor deaths in Madhya Pradesh’s Dewas, police nab 10 for illicit trade
item.description: The locals of the two villages have claimed that 13 people have died so far since September 26

item.title: Mumbai Police form SIT to probe Jarange’s ₹500 crore claim as Raut writes to Shah seeking ED probe
item.description: The claim by Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange Patil has stirred Maharashtra’s politics, drawing a wedge between the alliance partners

item.title: Solicitor-General to appear for Karnataka in bike-taxi case
item.description: Karnataka says HC’s decision to allow bike-taxis ignore poor safety standards of motorcycles, higher accident fatality rates, and congestion

item.title: Ex-DMK minister Anbil remanded to judicial custody till Nov 6
item.description: Chennai police took Tamil Nadu’s former School Education Minister into custody after his anticipatory bail plea was rejected; allegedly involved in a multi-crore scam to collect money from private school managements

item.title: Media association challenges privacy law in Supreme Court
item.description: A three-judge Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant is scheduled to hear a batch of petitions filed by activists on October 27

item.title: SHRC calls for checks on private clinics after boy’s death following tonsil surgery in Kannur
item.description: The Commission issued the directive to the Additional Chief Secretary, Health department, asking the authorities to verify the qualifications and registration of doctors and other staff working at such clinics.

item.title: Two Vande Bharat trains partially cancelled for signal work at Kalamassery station on Oct. 27
item.description: Two Vande Bharat services to be partially cancelled, while the Mangala Lakshadweep Superfast Express will be delayed by 90 minutes

item.title: BJP holds nationwide protests against Congress president’s 'derogatory' remarks on PM Modi’s late father
item.description: BJP leaders and workers protested near Sena Bhawan Circle and on Rajaji Marg, close to Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence, in Delhi

item.title: BJP stages protest over Kharge’s comments
item.description: Addressing the gathering, BJP leader and former Telangana Governor Tamilisai Soundararajan criticised Mr. Kharge for his comments

item.title: After slashing VAT on jet fuel, Tamil Nadu government asks airlines to add more services from Chennai airport
item.description: Sources say that after reduction of VAT from 29% to 16%, the airlines have assured the government that they would increase the number of flights, but haven’t given a time-frame for implementation

item.title: Maharashtra will prioritise its own interest on Telangana barrage project, says Fadnavis
item.description: Joint committee will be formed to do an independent study of the project’s impact

item.title: Minister Vanni Arasu inspects rain affected areas in Kallakurichi
State government relaxes norms for height restriction on non-high rise buildings
item.description: The State government has amended the Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules, 2019, relaxing height restriction on non-high rise buildings from 18.3 metres to 19.5 metres

item.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Custody of four accused extended till Oct 28; 11th accused remanded till Oct 31
item.description: Mumbai Crime Branch seeks to trace weapon supply, Signal communications and local support network; defence questions need for further custody

item.title: Five shot dead in Guwahati hotel
item.description: The victims include a mother-son duo; police nab one suspect

item.title: One held for rape and murder of six-year-old girl
Kuttiadi eyes river circuit to tap tourism potential
item.description: The proposed projects include a heritage walking trail and a happiness park in Kuttiadi; birdwatching, farm tourism and a walkway at Cherandathur Chira

item.title: VACB holds awareness session for government employees
item.description: The district will host various programmes until November 2 as part of the anti-corruption awareness campaign.

item.title: Suspected kingpin of drug network held in Malappuram
item.description: Police say Ibrahim Badusha played a key role in the network linked to the seizure of 12.8 kg of MDMA from Coimbatore in August

item.title: Kannur panchayat contracts: KSU vice-president challenges allegations, threatens legal action
item.description: The confrontation comes amid a fresh vigilance investigation into alleged irregularities in public works contracts worth more than ₹12 crore awarded to the company.

item.title: Madras High Court denies anticipatory bail to Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi in ₹100-crore private schools fraud case
item.description: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan dismisses his advance bail plea in a case being investigated by the Chennai Central Crime Branch police

item.title: Virtual autopsy at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital: launch likely to take time
item.description: The Forensic Medicine Department has submitted a detailed list of the facilities to be introduced at the hospital, including the staff to be appointed and the equipment to be installed, to the government

item.title: Six held after alleged drug-trade groups clash at police station
item.description: A search of the vehicles led to the seizure of 9 grams of MDMA and 10.5 grams of ganja, say police.

item.title: Water release from Mettur dam for irrigation suspended after about 50 days
item.description: Acknowledging the suspension of the release, an official says the idea is to build a comfortable storage at the dam before deciding to resume the release

item.title: Hare Krishna Vaikuntham begins month-long Damodara Deepotsavam
Karnataka SIR: Final electoral roll out on October 27; net additions remain minuscule
item.description: The final roll will have around 4.54 crore voters, with one crore names struck off the rolls

item.title: Two Reserved Forest Areas in Maharashtra to Be Declared Wildlife Sanctuaries; Approval Granted for 14 Conservation Reserves
item.description: The Kolamarka Conservation Reserve in Gadchiroli district, known for its population of wild buffaloes, has been approved for declaration as a wildlife sanctuary

item.title: Kuki-Zo insurgent camp taken over by CRPF in Manipur among two to be relocated under MHA deal
item.description: Police say 17 people found in Sinai camp were “impersonating” registered cadres; Kuki-Zo insurgent group says they were long-term residents, calls for Central intervention; SoO camps no longer “untouchable”, says senior official

item.title: Explosions reported at two locations in Kannavam
item.description: Explosions were reported near the Kannavam Range Forest Office and at Chunda around 11.10 p.m. on Sunday. Preliminary assessments suggest that crude bombs may have been used.

item.title: Vice-President calls for expansion of medical research in Universities
item.description: C. P. Radhakrishnan encourages students to dedicate their lives to finding solutions to health issues that plague society, and says the country has an adequate number of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students, and now focus must be on expanding research

item.title: CEC can be removed only like a Supreme Court judge, ECI tells top court
item.description: A common affidavit filed for the EC, CEC Kumar and Election Commissioners Sandhu and Joshi say that any attempt to restrain the CEC’s functioning is contrary to the 2023 Act; asserts that Form 6 was not amended; West Bengal CEO’s officers filed appeals against inclusions

item.title: Coimbatore school student’s death case: probe transferred to CB-CID
item.description: Coimbatore city police handed over a copy of the order to family members of the deceased, who along with relatives and members of various political parties have been staging a protest for the past few days, demanding arrest of all persons who abetted the suicide.

item.title: Health Department readies 6,431 emergency beds for cyclone
item.description: 630 medical teams, 716 vehicles kept ready; 1,075 pregnant women shifted to hospitals

item.title: A.P., Odisha on alert as cyclone ‘Arnab’ nears land
item.description: IMD issues red alerts for seven of the 28 districts in Andhra Pradesh for Tuesday; 4,711 pregnant women will be shifted to safer healthcare facilities, say officials; Odisha readies 1,700 shelters in five southern districts

item.title: Narayana directs civic officials to remain on high alert as cyclone nears
item.description: Minister asks officials to prevent waterlogging and shift residents of vulnerable areas to safety

item.title: ECI suspends six U.P. officials for dereliction of duty, polling booth lapses in Council polls
item.description: ECI says such serious lapses cannot be condoned, directs charge-sheets to be issued to delinquent officers; repoll in three polling booths in affected constituency conducted peacefully on Monday with 57% voter turnout

item.title: State government committed to strengthening ITDAs, resolving Podu land issues: Minister Adluri Laxman Kumar
Nelakondapalli Buddhist site in Telangana to be developed as international heritage and tourism destination: Minister
Rajasthan man arrested in Gujarat by Adilabad police in cyber fraud case
Schools shut, relief measures intensified in three North Andhra districts as cyclone nears
Telangana High Court directs government to file written submissions opposing bail for two BRS MLCs
BRS avoided Tummidihatti as per CWC recommendations on water availability: Harish Rao
BJP protest against Mallikarjun Kharge in Bengaluru
Provide 2.5% reservation to students of govt-aided schools in medical college admissions: Anbumani
item.description: Poor and disadvantaged students studying in government-aided schools are being denied social justice in admissions to medical courses, says PMK leader

item.title: BJP undermining democracy through vote chori, claims Kamaleshwar Patel
item.description: The CWC member says that as per the Registration of Electors Rules 1960, mentioning the reason for deletion of voter name is mandatory

item.title: Four charred to death as car catches fire, falls into culvert in Madhya Pradesh
item.description: Police say the incident took place on Mhow-Neemuch four-lane highway when one of the tyres burst and caught fire after which the car veered off the road and plunged into the culvert

item.title: One nation, one papad: The pursuit of food uniformity threatens India’s peace and progress
item.description: FSSAI’s papad norms, a backlash over beef dishes and an order on non-vegetarian food at Keralam Lok Bhavan highlight tensions between uniformity and cultural diversity

item.title: Very severe cyclone ‘Arnab’ to make landfall near Yanam-Kakinada; red alert issued for seven districts
item.description: Kakinada, East Godavari, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema, Eluru, West Godavari, Alluri Sitharama Raju, and Anakapalli districts likely to experience isolated extremely heavy rainfall, while Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, NTR, Krishna, Guntur, Bapatla, Srikakulam, Parvathipuram Manyam likely to receive heavy to very heavy rainfall on October 27

item.title: Rahul acquitted in 2018 defamation case over remarks on Amit Shah
item.description: The case alleged that Rahul Gandhi had called Amit Shah a “murder accused”; during the hearing, the Congress leader disputed the allegations and said the statement was presented out of context

item.title: Congress leaders accused of conspiring against Siddaramaiah
item.description: Kuruba leader Bailappa Nelogi says the Congress is maintaining silence over the sting operation involving the former Chief Minister

item.title: Govt. not worried about inflation as it knows only to steal votes, says Kharge
item.description: Congress chief appeals to citizens to join INDIA bloc’s Chalo Dilli rally on November 1; Rahul tells traders that Congress’ protest will end in ‘30 seconds’ if govt. sacks Chief Election Commissioner

item.title: Delhi teenager’s Project Sadak logs 2,927 road complaints across Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru; tracks 190 repairs
item.description: Inspired by an accident that left his parents injured, the 16-year-old built an AI-powered platform to report potholes and other road hazards, identify the departments responsible and track repairs.

item.title: Defence Minister slams Congress chief for his remarks on Prime Minister
item.description: Reacting to Mr. Kharge’s remarks on Mr. Modi, Rajnath Singh says political opposition should remain confined to policies and should not violate personal and family decorum

item.title: Karnataka government to decide on sugarcane issues after Central team’s visit
Andhra Pradesh braces for 11th very severe cyclonic storm
item.description: Arnab could be the first VSCS to affect the State since Titli in 2018; IMD records 10 such storms between 1970 and 2023

item.title: Slum development, environment top priorities if voted as GVMC Mayor, says Varudu Kalyani
